request.policy: Pinned input.lua uses frame>=first and frame<last; override flag is 1 on frames 2100-2102 and 0 on frame 2103; policy7 is separately recorded child configuration

input.sampledVsRequest: Request intervals and sampled port bytes are distinct. The AUX2 request is 2100..2103; sampled AUX2 is 00 on frame 2100 and 80 on frames 2101-2103, while the override flag drops to 0 on frame 2103. No conflated request/sample claim is made.

startRequest.note: The 56 pause-time rows are additional sampled rows at the physical-stop timestamps, not additional real 60 Hz frames; no future pulse beyond the observed rows is claimed.

standaloneToolResults.explanation: The standalone raw adapter and offline sequence checker always emit naturalProof=false by schema and were not edited. Their false flags describe their own diagnostic scope; they do not negate the separate supervisor provenance review.

supervisorAcceptedProofScope.status: supervisor-reviewed scope retained unchanged by this curation
supervisorAcceptedProofScope.scope: Limited trace-backed natural fresh-boot compiled-ROM MAME output/frame-RAM transition observed at the existing 9F14 caller.
evidenceBasis: One corrected prepare-02 execution recorded MAME exit 0 with explicit prelaunch child environment MPU4_REPLAY=prepare-02/replay-actions.csv and MPU4_POLICY=7.
43 mapped phases, 52 original physical stops, 4 output-window physical stops, 10 native boundary records and 4 conditional skips were observed.
Four frame-bank bytes changed from 3F to 3E at 010F, 011F, 012F and 013F with no other frame-bank byte delta.
The output window preserved mux=7, frame=0, sample=0 and selected RAM value 3E across the immediate write pair; the write pair is bound to output id 12483, name lamp120.
All 56 physical stops bind to exactly one input CSV row within 0 ns (maximum absolute delta 0.000000000 s).

limitations: This is a frame-RAM/output transition, not photographed or rendered physical lamp output.
Only the measured response-00, column-15, F1-zero path is naturally observed; future 0803 responses and optional non-zero F1 paths remain separate.
Debugger stops may affect timing; no unobserved-run timing equivalence is claimed.
No interactive gameplay, new scheduler/button semantics, general caller safety or M5 completion is claimed.
No physical hardware compatibility is claimed.
The prepare-01 run is diagnostic only because its prelaunch record lacks explicit replay environment values; it is not the accepted capture.
The selected RAM address 010F is derived from the observer read path and the raw x value; the raw scan row directly records selected=3E and x=0007.
No last or future input pulse beyond the observed CSV rows is claimed.
The standalone adapter/checker naturalProof=false flags remain untouched and are explained separately from the supervisor accepted scope.
